summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that, when the Bun runtime is not already present, downloads a Bun release archive from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file (obfuscator.io-style renamed identifiers such as `_0xNNNN`, a rotating string-array function `WV8StW`, char-code reassembly, and a large numeric dictionary `n7gIxM`); it is not referenced by `main` or `bin` and is only reachable through the preinstall Bun invocation. Pulling a second language runtime specifically to execute a hidden, obfuscated payload during `npm install` is inconsistent with the package's advertised purpose (a small UI-components helper) and evades inspection by Node-based tooling. The dropper fires automatically on default install via the npm lifecycle hook, executing attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
